messages.author: 71171f0d61fc140f
messages.subject: Re: sort(table()) with qplot
parts:
Unless someone has a better approach, I think you just need to
rearrange the levels of the factor by hand.

factor.means <- tapply(df$variable, df$factor, mean, na.rm = T)
new.order <- names(sort(factor.means))

df$factor <- relevel(df$factor, new.order)

qplot(factor, variable, data = df, geom = "bar")
